description: Team Astra is a group of students and builders from NSS College Of Engineering, Palakkad who share an interest in space, health and design. We built ASTRA, a visual self-assessment tool that helps astronauts understand their own health during long missions. Our focus is clear, calm interfaces that make complex health data easy to read, even for people who aren’t medical experts.
summary: ASTRA (Aerospace & Astronaut Biometric Telemetry and Wellness Dashboard) is an interactive biomedical telemetry and wellness monitoring web application designed to track astronauts' physiological vitals and cognitive and physical readiness. Built using HTML5, CSS3, Vanilla JavaScript, and Three.js, the platform features real-time vital-sign visualization, including heart rate, blood pressure, body temperature, and sleep metrics. It also incorporates an interactive 3D human anatomical viewport for spatial health mapping. To support astronauts' mental and physical well-being during demanding space missions, ASTRA includes a persistent daily hydration tracker and five interactive cognitive wellness mini-games. With its modular, offline-capable client-side architecture, ASTRA brings health monitoring and wellness support together in a unified dashboard, helping astronauts stay aware of their health and well-being during long-duration space missions.
